item.title: 1986 Alfa Romeo Spider Veloce at No Reserve
item.description: This 1986 Alfa Romeo Spider Veloce remained with its original owner until 2021 and shows 21k miles. It is finished in Alfa Red over tan leather and is powered by a 2.0L twin-cam inline-four paired with a five-speed manual transmission. Equipment includes a limited-slip differential, a replacement convertible top, a rear spoiler, four-wheel disc brakes, and 14" Campagnolo Daytona wheels as well as a cassette stereo, air conditioning, and bucket seats. item.title: 36k-Mile 2005 Audi S4 Cabriolet 6-Speed at No Reserve

item.description: This 1985 AMC Eagle sedan is powered by a modified inline-six that is noted to displace 4.6 liters and has been fitted with FAST fuel injection, an Offenhauser intake manifold, and a DUI distributor. Shifting is through an AX15 five-speed manual transmission that is linked to an NP242 transfer case, Yukon 3.08 gearing, and Tom Woods driveshafts. item.title: 2024 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Coupe 1LT

item.title: 22k-Mile 1997 Ferrari F355 Spider 6-Speed
item.description: This 1997 Ferrari F355 Spider shows 22k miles and is powered by a 3.5-liter DOHC V8 that received an engine-out timing belt service in preparation for the sale. Shifting is through a six-speed manual transaxle, and the car is finished in black over tan Connolly leather upholstery. Equipment includes a gated shifter, a black soft top, pop-up headlights, an Alpine stereo, automatic climate control, and drilled aluminum pedals. item.title: Shelby Daytona Coupe CSX9000
item.description: This Shelby Daytona Coupe is a CSX9000 continuation model that was purchased new by the current owner in 2013. item.description: This 1987 Lamborghini Countach is one of approximately 610 examples of the 5000 Quattrovalvole variant produced between 1985 and 1988, a claimed 66 of which were specified for the US market with Bosch K-Jetronic fuel injection.
